label: caiso 9 full-year 2025 bench
definition: Current-main CAISO 3-yr keeper, re-solved. Fixes the truncated 2025 per-class benchmark: the early monthly-survey vintage (~73% of plants) under-counts every non-thermal class, so wind/solar/hydro now source the EIA-930 grid total and biomass is carried from the prior year scaled by vintage completeness — every class gets a full-year 2025 benchmark (wind 4.2->19.8, solar 39.8->49.9, hydro 12.4->21.4, biomass 1.2->3.2 TWh). Thermal stays on its CAMPD full-year backfill (CC_REGULAR ~37.5 is the genuine 2025 value, CEMS-confirmed). Also adds per-year EIA-860 CHP classification. Dispatch is unchanged vs caiso-7 (benchmark-side fix); the midday LMP floor / 0 negative hours remains the open structural item.
